title: GTA 6 Locks Every Cheat Until You Beat All 91 Missions 🔒 #Shorts
description:
GTA 6 cheats stay locked until you finish the story's 91 missions, and each of the 61 cheats has its own challenge — from catching 100 fish to holding hands for 4 hours. Using cheats turns off trophies and saving.

Sources: Engadget (GTA 6 launch day live blog) and Red Bull ("GTA 6 cheats: All the codes and how to unlock them", 11/18/2026).
Images: official Rockstar Games trailers.
